scope: Production UI components -> substituted desktop transport -> production stdio Main/Controller -> real HTTP/managed PipeWire, with injected inactive model services. Not a native Tauri/full application acceptance.

measurement_boundary.start_click: Python monotonic immediately before Playwright click; includes actionability, browser dispatch and substituted process bridge
measurement_boundary.start_stdio: Python monotonic immediately before writing the actual encoded line to child stdin
measurement_boundary.audio_end: First20ms source frame read with peak>64/32768; not an audio-device timestamp or PCM write time
measurement_boundary.silence_end: First read of >=2s continuous silence; continuous capture and node identity checked per case
measurement_boundary.budgets: stdio stop<=250ms; browser click stop<=500ms diagnostic only; server listener failure<=250ms per observed case
measurement_boundary.samples: Five completed utterances across distinct normal/resume/translated/recovery conditions per final run; single cancel/mute/crash each; no quantiles or upper-bound guarantees
measurement_boundary.performance_gate: Spec8 UI-event->first non-silent write p50<350ms/p95<800ms NOT evaluated; fixture transport and read boundary differ

injected_services: Tauri backend_subprocess handle bridged via Playwright; responses polled20ms
config test object; no application config persistence
history and websocket call recording; no persistence/websocket transport
real_legacy_boundary: Production OSCHandler sends localhost UDP to isolated test receiver; no VRChat destination
